original.statement: PartialRefinement u s (fun w => IsCompact (closure w))) (hs : IsCompact s) (i : ι) (hi : i ∉ v.carrier) : ∃ v' : PartialRefinement u s (fun w => IsCompact (closure w)), v < v' ∧ IsCompact (closure (v' i))
